component.name: Splash
component.summary: Run coding agents in your git projects

description.p: Splash is a desktop app for running coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. It talks to them over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and shows what they stream back: messages, tool calls, diffs, plans and permission requests.
Each session is one agent working in one project folder. In a git repository it can run in a separate worktree on its own branch. Agents are installed separately.
